name: Question 6
problem:
The velocity $v$ at time $t$ of a particle $P$ moving in the $xy$-plane is given by

$$
v(t)=⟨6t-1,{t}^{2}-1⟩.
$$

Given that the particle is at the position $r=⟨10,-1⟩$ when $t=3,$ calculate the position of $P$ at time $t=1.$

b
